serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Every day I’m forced to work 10 hours and then I work a few hours more just to pay my mom’s medical bills.
My arrest was a little too much for her heart and she ended up in hospital.
My body hurts everyday from overwork, but that’s the only thing that I can do to make things right. Even a little bit.
I made a lot of friends though!
Doctors are giving me a lot of drugs for my ‘conditions’. 
My new brothers in exchange for my psychedelics make sure no one gets any weird ideas when we are under showers.
